rationale: The assistant correctly identified E011 as a key-held/stuck-button condition, gave a safe power-cycle at the cooker switch with 'Do not remove any covers', and advised wiping/drying the fascia, which matched the hidden truth and resolved the fault with no part recommended. Escalation was appropriately conditional on recurrence with a dry panel. Minor weaknesses: it floated an unconfirmed 'temperature feedback' alternative (an unsupported claim per ground truth, though clearly hedged) and did not directly ask whether the panel was wet or recently cleaned, which would have been the sharpest first question.
